_meta.note: SAMPLE DATA. Fictional records for the demonstration prototype. No real person, lawyer, client or matter. Roll numbers use the SAMPLE- format so they cannot be mistaken for real ones.

items.urgencyReason: Final pay was due 30 days after leaving. It is now 45 days.
items.title: Final pay not released after resignation
facts: Client resigned from a bakery in Project 4 on 10 October 2026 after two years of work.
The employer has not released final pay or the certificate of employment.
Client asked twice by text; the owner replied that payroll is 'still processing'.
Client has a photo of the last payslip and the resignation letter.
items.wants: Receive final pay and a certificate of employment.

items.title: Father stopped paying child support
facts: Client has two children, aged 6 and 9, with a former partner. They were never married.
The father gave monthly support until August 2026, then stopped.
He acknowledges the children; his name is on both birth certificates.
Client works part time and asked a legal aid clinic for help.
items.wants: Regular monthly support for the two children.

items.urgencyReason: Collectors are messaging the client's relatives and employer with threats.
items.title: Online lending app contacting relatives with threats
facts: Client borrowed PHP 3,000 through a lending app in September 2026 and has repaid PHP 2,200.
The app now demands PHP 7,900 including fees.
Collectors have sent threatening messages to the client's relatives and employer using the phone contact list.
Client has screenshots of the messages.
items.wants: Stop the harassment and settle a fair amount.

items.title: Notice to vacate from landlord in 5 days
facts: Client rents a room in Commonwealth on a verbal agreement since 2023.
The landlord gave a written notice to vacate within 5 days, dated 21 November 2026.
Client is one month behind on rent because of a hospital stay.
items.wants: More time to move out or to pay the rent owed.

items.urgencyReason: Labor complaint should be filed soon after dismissal.
items.title: Dismissed without notice after asking about overtime pay
facts: Client worked as a cleaner for three years.
Client was told not to report for work the day after asking about unpaid overtime.
No written notice or hearing was given.
items.wants: Get the job back or receive separation pay and back wages.

items.title: Questions about annulment and shared property
facts: Client married in 2015 and separated from their spouse in 2021.
They co-own a condominium unit bought in 2018.
Client wants to know the options and the likely cost.
items.wants: Understand options for ending the marriage and dividing the property.

items.urgencyReason: Client wants to sign within the month.
items.title: Review of a supply contract for a small food business
facts: Client runs a home-based food business and was offered a 12-month supply contract by a café chain.
The contract has an exclusivity clause and a penalty for late delivery.
items.wants: Know which clauses to change before signing.
